recentItems.title: A Year To Remember - 1966 (Full Documentary Episode)
recentItems.description:
The classic series that recalls the definitive events of the 20th century, year by year, as they were reported at the time.

In this episode: - India: Gandhi chosen for president- Vietnam War- England wins World Cup- Ronald Reagan's presidential race- The Swinging Sixties- Britain's first nuclear-powered Polaris submarine
